match.userMessage: One greyscale storyboard frame. Frozen in this action: Scarlett descends two flights and turns her chin toward her reflection in the wired-glass window. Framing: medium wide, slightly above, Scarlett moves diagonally through the concrete stairwell, black rail leading toward her and sunlit landings creating alternating bands of light across her face. Placement only, not the pose: Scarlett begins descending the stairs with one hand near the black rail, her phone secured and lipstick tucked away. Camera, as one or two arrows: pan, smooth. Characters: Scarlett, Female, 20s, A sharp-eyed young woman of medium height, A sleek black turtleneck with a streamlined black-and-neutral. The bodies are frozen in that action: if someone sits, they are seated; if someone reaches, the arm is extended. One figure per character. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Camera travel is one or two arrows. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
